Anything beyond the third party's own access; the content of a filing it describes, until the filing itself is retrieved
4.2 What common US filings do and do not show.

Establish that the item is what it appears to be. A filing retrieved from the registry's own system is a different item from a copy of it hosted elsewhere. Check metadata, and compare dates inside the document with the page's dates.

A news report of a filing is evidence of what the reporter wrote. Its origin is OSINT_SOURCED. When the filing itself is retrieved from the regulator's own system, it becomes a second evidence item with origin REGULATORY_PUBLIC_RECORD. An evidence item names only what the researcher actually read.
A filing to, or a record kept by, a regulator, statutory registry or court, retrieved from that body's own system
An official publication of a public body or public-sector institution, issued in its official capacity and not as a filing to a regulator
A filing is still the filer's own account. REGULATORY_PUBLIC_RECORD says where it was filed, not that it is true.
A subject's filing and the same subject's press release are one originating source for facts only the subject can supply. Together they do not make a claim CORROBORATED (see

Filings are the filers' own accounts. A body's acceptance of a filing does not by itself establish that its content is true; for Form ADV the SEC states that accepting the form is not a finding that it was completed correctly.

Every evidence item records its capture date and time, the artefact's own publication or filing date, and the as-of date of the value, using the date vocabulary of the Evidence & Provenance Standard. These dates are never substituted for one another.
A copy of a filing hosted by an aggregator.
It is OSINT_SOURCED until the filing is retrieved from the regulator's or registry's own system.

手順・やり方.quote: methodologies: Analytic products should identify underlying sources and methodologies upon
Altss Private Markets OSINT Verification Standard | Altss Frameworks
Inspect the methodology

The Altss standard for verifying publicly accessible private-markets information: Berkeley Protocol-aligned source, item and content verification, the three evidence dimensions with origin kept separate from collection method, source grading, ICD 203 language for judgments, and source-rights recording.
5. Method
The record kept for each evidence item about a private-markets entity or event: identifier, retrieval date, fixed copy or fingerprint, collection method and rights basis.
Source Reliability & Confidence Methodology
Entity Resolution Methodology
Temporal Data & Freshness Methodology
Investment Signal Classification Methodology

The standing of a source for a type of claim (RECORD_KEEPER, SUBJECT, DIRECT_ACCESS, COPY_OR_COMPILATION or UNATTRIBUTED), a grade of how dependable it has been for that type of claim (A to F), and a grade of how well an item of information is supported (1 to 6), all defined in the Source Reliability & Confidence Methodology. See
the collection method, as process metadata (rule 6.2);
describes the quality and credibility of its underlying sources and methods;
Rules 6.1 to 6.4 set out the Altss evidence model. It is an Altss-defined methodology, not an industry standard.
6.2 Collection method is not origin.

The collection method is recorded separately, with each capture, as process metadata and is never an origin value. Origin follows the artefact: a Form ADV has origin REGULATORY_PUBLIC_RECORD, a news article OSINT_SOURCED and a statement the subject gives in answer to a request DISCLOSED, however each was obtained.

— the disciplined set of standards and methods that turn open-source information into a sound, defensible judgment. It covers the U.S. Intelligence Community analytic standards, the structured analytic techniques that meet them, and the source-evaluation discipline every open-source analyst needs.
Analytic tradecraft is the disciplined set of methods, standards, and habits that separate professional intelligence analysis from opinion, punditry, or a news summary. It is concerned less with

Tradecraft exists because the human mind is predictably biased. It anchors on first impressions, sees patterns in noise, favors evidence that confirms what it already believes, and grows overconfident as it accumulates detail. Structured methods and explicit standards are countermeasures: they force the analyst to slow down, externalize reasoning, and test judgments before publishing them.
are the structured methods an analyst uses to meet those standards. Standards tell you what good looks like; techniques are how you get there.

The workhorse contrarian technique, treated step by step. ACH inverts intuitive analysis: instead of asking which evidence supports the preferred explanation, it asks which hypothesis is least contradicted by the evidence. 突き合わせ・推定.quote: DERIVED and ESTIMATED values have no origin of their own. Their origin is the set of origins of their inputs.
For DERIVED and ESTIMATED values, validation covers the inputs and the correct application of the rule or method. Validation never turns an ESTIMATED value into an OBSERVED one.

Reliability and credibility grades are judgments. Irwin and Mandel (2019) argue that the Admiralty-style scales mask subjectivity and recommend numeric probability estimates and periodic re-evaluation. This standard keeps ordinal grades for sources and information, requires reasons for each, and uses numeric ranges for likelihood judgments.
